CustomField.formula:
IF (ISBLANK(To_Observations__c), "",
IF(HOUR(To_Observations__c) <= 12, TEXT(HOUR(To_Observations__c)), TEXT(HOUR(To_Observations__c)-12)) & ":" &
IF (MINUTE(To_Observations__c) < 10, "0" + TEXT(MINUTE(To_Observations__c)), TEXT(MINUTE(Time_Breakfast_Medication__c))) &
IF (HOUR(To_Observations__c) < 12, " AM", " PM"))
CustomField.label: To Observations Formula
